claims.statement: Management expects mid-single-digit value growth for the full year.
claims.quote: We are looking at mid-single-digit value growth for the full year.
claims.speaker: management

claims.statement: Management anticipates that the gap between volume and value will remain in the zone of 4-5%.
claims.quote: And therefore, we would anticipate that the gap between the volume and the value would remain in that zone of about 4-5%.
claims.speaker: management

claims.statement: Management maintains the PBDIT margin band guidance of 18 to 20%.
claims.quote: Given all this, it is okay to maintain the whole guidance of 18 to 20% PBDIT margin band.
claims.speaker: management

facts.statement: Net sales grew by 6.4% on a standalone perspective, supported by decorative, industrial and international business.
facts.quote: net sales grew by 6.4%, supported by growth across decorative, industrial and international business.

facts.statement: Gross margins at the standalone level stood at 43.1%, higher by 250 bps.
facts.quote: Gross margins at 43.1% was higher by 250 bps.

facts.statement: The company declared an interim dividend of Rs. 4.5.
facts.quote: We have declared interim dividend of Rs. 4.5.
